manage.lead: Watch most; refer high-risk ones early.

points: Oral propranolol, specialist-initiated with monitoring; hold doses if not feeding or unwell.

items.t: Periocular, airway/beard, lip, nasal tip, segmental facial, perineal, ulcerated or ≥5 lesions: refer ideally by about 4 weeks of age.

quiz.q: When does most haemangioma growth occur?
quiz.a: In the first 1–3 months; largely complete by about 5 months.

quiz.q: Which marker distinguishes IH from malformations?

quiz.a: Oral propranolol, started by a specialist.
